_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); pharmaceutical signals

pit_profile.why: 'We discover, develop, manufacture, and market products in two business segments—human pharmaceutical products and animal health products.' (FY2015 10-K, Item 1); 'We depend on products with intellectual property protection for most of our revenues, cash flows, and earnings; we have lost or will lose effective intellectual property protection for many of those products in the next several years, which may result in rapid and severe declines in revenues.' (FY2015 10-K, Item 1A heading); 'Our long-term success depends on intellectual property protection; if our intellectual property rights are invalidated, circumvented, or weakened, our business will be adversely affected.' (FY2015 10-K, Item 1A heading); 'We face intense competition from multinational pharmaceutical companies, biotechnology companies, and lower-cost generic and biosimilar manufacturers, and such competition could have a material adverse effect on our business.' (FY2015 10-K, Item 1A heading); 'For non-biological products, loss of exclusivity (whether by expiration or as a consequence of litigation) typically results in the entry of one or more generic competitors, leading to a rapid and severe decline in revenues, especially in the U.S.' (FY2015 10-K, Item 1A); 'Our product revenues can be adversely affected by the introduction by competitors of branded products that are perceived as superior by the marketplace, by generic or biosimilar versions of our branded products, and by generic or biosimilar versions of other products in the same therapeutic class as our branded products.' (FY2015 10-K, Item 1A)

BEAR.desc: EPS -48.4%/yr (worst year FY06-FY15 ex-FY08, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +2.7%/yr (FY16 guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr ex-FY08 median

BULL.desc: EPS +2.7%/yr (FY06-FY15 ex-FY08 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +20.6%/yr (best 2-yr run FY06-FY15 ex-FY08); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: LLY (retrospective, 2016-03-18) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B 1299.00x (91.5% downside to Bear $6 / +0.1% upside to Bull $71) | Adj composite 1.86 vs market 3.30: gap -1.44 [OVERVALUED] | +76% above the EPP floor $40 (14x FY16E $2.88) | Conservative 2-yr case: -44.7% total (-22.4%/yr) | At 24.6x FY16E the 15% hurdle price $94 sits above the BULL case; U.S. revenues +15.0% in Q4 2015, forward revenues +1.2-3.7% (FY16 revenue guide); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
